# Safety Last Soundpainting Ensemble

> Belgian ensemble based in Ghent that composes all its music and text live through Soundpainting, the multidisciplinary sign language developed by New York composer Walter Thompson. Founded in 2023 at the request of Music Centre De Bijloke (Ghent). Soundpainter and founder: Johan Sabbe.

Walter Thompson on the ensemble: "One of the best Soundpainting groups I have ever worked with. They offer so much and are so interesting to work with. It is just phenomenal."

The name reflects the ensemble's philosophy: together on the tightrope, without a safety net, in search of ephemeral compositions that leave the beaten path. Nothing is agreed in advance; the ensemble looks for sound structures that could be made neither by improvisation nor by written composition.

## Programmes

- **Landscapes**: a performance that attunes itself to its surroundings. It can stand alone as a concert performance or connect with themes of a venue, city or community (ecology, urban development, heritage, architecture, the relationship between people and their environment). Can be extended with participatory trajectories or local input.
- **Harold Lloyd's Safety Last**: a new soundtrack composed live to the 1923 silent film classic. Every performance is different. Also available as a school performance with a teaching pack.

## Members

- Johan Sabbe: Soundpainter
- Loeke Van Houtteghem: voice & spoken word
- Ruth Mareen: violin
- Anthe Huybrechts: synthesizer & voice
- Kris Matthynssens: viola
- Dirk Moelants: viola da gamba
- Nathalie Van Meirvenne: bass flute
- Ward Ginneberge: accordion
- Laurens Van Bouwelen: percussion
- Flor Delombaerde: double bass
- Ward De Vleeschhouwer: piano
- Kobe Wens: foley & video

## Collaborations

- Walter Thompson (creator of Soundpainting)
- Batik Soundpainting Orchestra (Clermont-Ferrand, France)
- Orquestra Galega de Liberación (Santiago de Compostela, Spain)
